title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
description: Brand is told to expect a prison sentence "of some length" and faces more rape allegations, it can now be reported.

title: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
description: Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults at Southwark Crown Court.

title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
description: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms

title: Henry Nowak’s killer has minimum term increased to 25 years by Court of Appeal
description: Judges ruled Vickrum Digwa's original term was unduly lenient and refused his bid to have it cut.

title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
description: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

title: King relishes 'politically charged' deployments, Palace aide says
description: The monarch faced questions on the UK's involvement in the slave trade during his Caribbean tour.

title: Messages reveal how hoax threat was passed on by air traffic control
description: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.

title: UK doctor infected with Ebola being treated at London hospital
description: The doctor tested positive in DR Congo, where there is an outbreak. The government says the risk to the public remains low.

title: Police car set alight in Glasgow amid Bonfire Night trouble
description: The car was torched after officers answered reports of an injured man in the Provanmill area of Glasgow.
